title: Test vectors: cert chain validation and cross-signing
description: Create test vector suite for X.509 attestation cert validation. Vectors must cover: (1) valid single-CA chain, (2) valid cross-signed chain (two CAs), (3) expired cert rejection, (4) wrong-key-usage rejection, (5) unknown CA rejection, (6) self-signed CA acceptance when in trust store, (7) chain depth limit, (8) Yggdrasil /128 SAN validation matches node identity, (9) hybrid ML-DSA/Ed25519 chain (future-proofing). Generate certs using Python cryptography library. Vectors in test/vectors/ca_attestation.json. All three impls must match.
